correctness.rationale: For B_k=binom(3k,k)-2binom(3k,k-1)+binom(3k,k-2), reconstruct Shankar T=1+zT^3 and B(z)=T(T-2)^2/(3-2T), F(s)=B(1/s)/s. Boundary branch at 1/x, x=(4c^2-1)^3/(4c^2), c in (1/2,1), has T=u+iv with u=2c^2-1/2 and v=(4c^2-1)sqrt(1-c^2)/(2c). Stieltjes jump and Jacobian give w(c)=(64c^6-112c^4+44c^2+7)/(4 pi c^2 sqrt(1-c^2)). Endpoint bounds F(s)=O(|s|^-2/3) at zero and O(|s-27/4|^-1/2) at other endpoint permit keyhole contour reconstruction, hence integral identity for ALL k. With y=c^2, cubic P(y) has critical minimum P(11/12)=68/27>0 and endpoints positive. X increases from 0 to 27/4; compact positive continuous-support measure is unique. Andreief plus strictly positive generalized Vandermonde determinants proves ALL Hankel minors. Independently computed multiple B_k and high-precision integral moments through k>=7 and symbolic derivative/positivity; finite moments not the all-k argument.
